why.onscreen: 'SAGITTARIUS A' is a name most viewers don't know, so it carries no stakes. The script's half a million miles an hour, happening right now, does.

beats: There's a monster at the center of our galaxy.
Sagittarius A* — a black hole four million times the mass of the Sun.
Every star in the Milky Way, including ours, is slowly orbiting it.
Right now you are circling a black hole at half a million miles an hour, and you can't feel a thing.
You've been orbiting it your whole life.
